description: Reference carry: rank 1 team named in turn 0; follow-ups say 'they'.

turns.query: Who won the 2022-2023 Premier League title?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_team FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 1;

turns.query: What goal difference did they finish with?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goal_difference FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 1;

turns.query: Who was their top scorer that season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_top_scorer_name, tss_top_scorer_goals FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2022-2023' AND tss_rank = 1;
